title: Smart home remote with undo
description: A smart home remote executes commands (turn a light on or off) and supports undo. Command is an interface with execute() and undo(). LightOnCommand and LightOffCommand wrap a Light and implement both methods. RemoteControl executes commands and keeps a history stack for undo. Implement the two command classes and RemoteControl.
hints: LightOnCommand.execute() calls light.turnOn(); undo() calls light.turnOff()
RemoteControl.pressButton() executes the command and pushes it onto a stack; pressUndo() pops and calls undo()
issues: Without the Command pattern, the remote must know about every device's specific methods, making it impossible to add undo generically
Adding a new device action requires changing the remote
overallGoal: Use the Command pattern so RemoteControl works with any command through the Command interface, and undo is automatic via the history stack.
goals: execute() and undo() on each command correctly toggle the light's state
pressUndo() reverses the last executed command
pressUndo() on an empty history does nothing
